feeds.title: UK Carp & Coarse Fishing
feeds.description: Fishy Tales & Storys. I have been fishing since I was about 7 years old, I started on small local rivers in Suffolk, where I was born. Then moved onto gravel pits and then carp fishing. My personal best is a 39.08 mirror, over recent years I have dallied in river fishing again on the Hampshire Avon which is a nice break from the carp lakes. This year I am planning to concentrate on the on the river for the carp, rather than the lakes & hope catch some nice chub & barbel.
